description: Everything DNS says about one domain in a single call: whether it is registered, its A and AAAA addresses, nameservers, MX servers, SPF and DMARC, DNSSEC, and whether it looks parked. Built for going through a list of domains one at a time. Live DNS, no API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

domain.description: The domain to check. A full URL or an email address is accepted and reduced to its host.
